turns.text: Hi, yes. My flight to Paris has been delayed and nobody has told me anything useful.
I'm sorry about the delay. To look at your booking, I need your booking code and the last name on it.
It's ZZ8Q2R. Moreau. Look, it's ninety minutes, that's ridiculous.
Thank you, Mr. Moreau. I can see Dubai to Paris SK312 today at 19:15, now delayed to 20:45 by Skyline Air operations. What would you like to do?
I want to be rebooked. And I want a hotel. Actually no, I don't need a hotel, just get me on something earlier.

Since the delay was caused by Skyline Air operations, I can rebook you for free with no fare difference onto the next available flight. A hotel voucher is only offered when an airline-caused delay runs overnight, so I can't offer one for this delay.
Fine. What's the next flight to Paris?
The next Dubai to Paris flight is SK310 at 09:00 tomorrow, Economy, with seats available. Shall I move you to that one?
Tomorrow? No. The 19:15 is still going, so that's not next available. Are there other flights today?
In my inventory I only have SK310 at 09:00 tomorrow for Paris. I can offer a supervisor callback if you want someone to check other options.
So I'm stuck with nothing. Fine, callback.
I'm sorry. I've requested a supervisor callback for your booking. Summary: SK312 delayed to 20:45 by operations, no rebooking made, supervisor callback requested. Is there anything else?
